lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Theodule eats.
You left room for separate dishes. Nobody at this table needs one this week: there is a single cook.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Smoky Summer Harvest Bowl
dishes.title: Smoky bean stew with roasted tofu and charred broccoli
dishes.method: Assemble the meal by placing a portion of the warm smoky bean stew in a bowl, topping it with the roasted smoked tofu and charred broccoli florets.
dishes.why: This dish provides a smoky, slow-cooked flavour profile using beans and tofu to meet the vegan requirement for the shared table.

dishes.name: Smoky Chicken and Bean Pot
dishes.title: Smoky bean stew with roasted chicken and broccoli
dishes.method: Assemble the plate by serving the charred broccoli first, followed by the roasted chicken fillets and a portion of the smoky bean stew.
dishes.why: Aurele receives a high-protein version of the smoky stew with chicken instead of tofu.

dishes.name: Warming Smoky Bean Supper
dishes.title: Reheated smoky bean stew with tofu and broccoli
dishes.method: Gently reheat the bean stew in a pan on the hob. Once hot, stir in the tofu and broccoli to warm through before serving in a bowl.
dishes.why: A warm, slow-cooked style dinner that remains vegan for the shared table.

dishes.name: Late Night Smoky Chicken Stew
dishes.title: Reheated smoky chicken and bean stew with broccoli
dishes.method: Reheat the bean stew and chicken in a pan until piping hot. Serve the broccoli first, then top with the chicken and stew.
dishes.why: Aurele's dinner is reheated to provide a warm, protein-rich meal late in the evening.

preparations.title: Smoky Three-Bean and Tomato Base
preparations.method: Sauté the onions and garlic in olive oil until soft. Add the smoked paprika and stir for a minute. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and all the beans. Simmer on low heat for 25 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the flavours are deep.

preparations.title: Charred Smoked Paprika Broccoli
preparations.method: Cut the broccoli into bite-sized florets. Toss with olive oil, smoked paprika, and salt. Spread on a single oven tray and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until charred at the edges.

preparations.title: Roasted Chicken and Smoked Tofu
preparations.method: Place the chicken fillets on one side of a tray and the tofu slices on the other. Drizzle with oil and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the tofu is firm.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven to 200C. Prepare the broccoli and get it into the oven on the first tray. While it roasts, start the onion and bean stew on the hob. After 20 minutes, remove the broccoli and swap it for the second tray containing the chicken and tofu. Continue simmering the beans until the protein is roasted, then weigh and box all components into the named containers.
